site_name: SevenFourEight, Ravenscraig Regeneration Area (former Ravenscraig steelworks)
address: Land at Ravenscraig Regeneration Area, Wishaw, Motherwell

site_area_m2.notes: Reported as 'approximately 160 acres' (~64.75 ha); red-line boundary not retrieved. Developer consultation material describes plots east and west of the Ravenscraig masterplan area.

number_of_buildings.notes: Six data halls on the eastern site plus three buildings on the western site, per consultation material.

current_land_use: Vacant remediated post-industrial land within the Ravenscraig masterplan regeneration area
previous_land_use: Ravenscraig steelworks (closed 1992); described as one of Europe's largest brownfield regeneration sites
land_notes: The 'SevenFourEight' plot is reported to lie east of the Wishaw Deviation freight railway line within the Ravenscraig masterplan area; consultation material also shows a western plot. Coordinates are an approximate centroid of the eastern Ravenscraig regeneration land, not taken from a red-line plan — precision set accordingly. Land owned by Ravenscraig Ltd (Scottish Enterprise / Wilson Bowden / Tata Steel UK JV).
